description: Give one user an experimental feature (allow), keep it off for them (deny) or remove their grant (clear). Identify the user by numeric userId or exact email; the result shows only the user id. Changes one user at a time and is written to the audit log. It cannot change a rollout, a rule or the kill switch, and it cannot opt anyone in to a feature that spends their API keys. Admins only. Requires signing in (admin:features).

access.description: allow gives the user the feature, deny keeps it off even for their role, clear removes the user's grant.

email.description: The user, by exact account email. Give userId or email.

expiresInDays.description: Days until an allow or deny grant expires.

reason.description: Why, kept in the audit log. Do not include personal data.

userId.description: The user, by numeric user id. Give userId or email.

name: set_feature_access
title: Give or remove a feature for one user (admin)
